concerns.text: Plan lists `code/00_checksum_verify.py` as a Constitution III deliverable, but no task implements it; checksumming is folded into T001 step 3. The plan-referenced component has no matching task and the plan/structure mismatch is unreconciled — either add a task or note the consolidation in the plan.

SC-003 requires measuring the family-wise error rate against alpha=0.05. T007r only produces corrected p-values from a single run; no task produces FWER evidence. SC-003 is listed as covered in the coverage table but has no demonstrating task for its stated measurement.

Plan's FR-004 note requires 'enforces a minimum number of scaffolds per fold' (20 per fold); T001 only checks total unique scaffolds >= 100 and writes splits.json with no per-fold scaffold minimum verification. The per-fold enforcement element of the plan has no task.

Data model specifies diagnostics outputs at `reports/diagnostics/vif_report.json` and `mi_report.json`; T008r writes a single `reports/metrics/diagnostics.json`. The data-model element's specified storage location has no matching task output — reconcile one way or the other.

Spec edge case requires 'chunking or subsampling logic' for extremely large molecules; T001 instead filters MW > 1000 Da. The spec-authorized mechanism has no implementing task and the deviation is undocumented in the spec.
T005r reuses the ID prefix of preserved verified task T005 for a different deliverable (resolution sweep), risking conflation between completed T005 and pending T005r during execution/verification.
